title: RockStar - Killing Me Slowly
htmlContent:
Washington-based artist RockStar has released a new track called "Killing Me Slowly". "Killing Me Slowly" is a a catchy record with endless smooth vibes. The music is laced with infectious grooves and dreamy pad work to make you want to move, as you get lost in the sound. The vocal performance is packed with a signature swagger full of conviction, with his incredible display of emceeing that makes his presence felt on this smash.
